housing.process: turned 4130 bar, OD88 tube + r56 flange ring w/ 4 bolt bosses (16 thk); bore finish-machined AFTER welding

ear1_boss.process: turned 4130 boss OD24, reamed after welding

ear1_web.process: 8 mm 4130 plate web, housing -> ear boss, top edge tapers into the wing

ear2_boss.process: turned 4130 boss OD24, reamed after welding

ear2_web.process: 8 mm 4130 plate web, housing -> ear boss, top edge tapers into the wing

abs_boss.process: turned 4130 slug d32 (OEM ABS boss), face x=72 and 17 mm bore machined after welding

tongue.process: 7 mm cheeks (OEM clamp faces x=-13.8/+14.9, faced after welding), 4 mm centre web, 4 mm caps, 5 mm end plate, 2 crush sleeves (d+10 OD)

tongue_root.process: two 6 mm side gussets + cap, tongue root -> flange ring

keel.process: 8 mm 4130 keel gusset under the tongue, housing OD -> tongue bottom cap

wing.process: 8 mm 4130 plate wing, laser cut, flush with the flange top (z 82)

carrier_7075.process: one-piece 7075-T651 lower eye carrier, 3-axis from 2.25" plate + angle-block for the two tilted eyes; 6x M10 12.9 into the wing (M10 weld nuts / tapped 8 mm wing + backing bar)

wing_pads.process: 6 weld nuts / bosses under the wing for the carrier bolts
